correctness.rationale: Under d≥2, α>0, λ=(d+1)/2+α, μ>λ+2 and fixed ε>0, the Euclidean 1F2 tail has radial leading z^(−2λ) and relative −λ(μ−1)(μ−2)ε²/z²; oscillatory remainder is lower order. With area measure the spherical Bessel-square identity is exact. The Mellin ratio is (λ−1/2)/[λ(ν−λ)(ν+λ)]; gamma-shift sum 1 makes relative 1/ν term vanish, and Bernoulli B3 gives quadratic λ(λ−1)(λ−1/2)/3. Their sum yields Q=(λ−1/2)[λ(λ−1)/3−(μ−1)(μ−2)ε²]. Uniform Bessel suppression for z<ν/2 and positivity for z≥ν/2 justify integrating remainders. Strict monotonicity in ε² gives unique ε*; symbolic check at λ=5/2, μ=6 gives ε*=1/4. No uniform-parameter or endpoint μ=λ+2 claim is made.
